what_changed: Event purpose changed from casual background cafe music to a café launch night with around 80 guests.
Performance format shifted from 3 hours of background ambience to a dedicated 45-minute headline set.
Budget increased from 7k–9k to up to 15k.
Space constraint updated: a small performance area can now be cleared for the artist.
requirement_shape_change_explanation: The requirement shifted fundamentally from continuous, low-attention background ambience to a focused, high-engagement headline performance for 80 guests. This changes the core capabilities required from endurance and background textural play to stage presence, performance delivery, and holding an audience's attention during a dedicated set.

reasons: Demonstrates capability as a full live band and multi-member acoustic ensemble, which is ideal for creating a headline 'moment' and holding an 80-person crowd's attention.
Demonstrates diverse instrumentation (electric/acoustic guitars, bass, drums, flute, and vocals) providing the dynamic energy needed for a launch event.
relevant_demonstrated_signals: Band instrumentation and live ensemble setup (electric guitar, bass, drums, vocals)
Acoustic duo/trio performance (acoustic guitar, flute, vocals)
trade_offs: Requires slightly more space than a pure solo act, though the brief confirms a small performance area can now be cleared.
assumptions_made: The increased budget of up to 15k accommodates a multi-member band or ensemble.

reasons: Demonstrates strong acoustic guitar performance and professional live gear setups (pedalboards, vocal mics), ensuring reliable sound projection for an 80-guest launch night.

summary_of_what_changed_and_why: The brief transformed from casual background music into a high-visibility launch night requiring a focused 45-minute headline performance for 80 guests, supported by an increased budget of up to 15k and a dedicated performance area. This shift elevates multi-member band and ensemble capabilities (M04_KillRush) alongside well-equipped acoustic acts (M01_Meera_Arjun) to deliver the necessary stage presence and crowd engagement.
